Here at Yamaha Motor Manufacturing Corporation of America in Newnan, Georgia we have been manufacturing world-class recreational vehicles for over 30 years.

Join our team [...] Yamaha’s high-tech factory utilizes the efforts of engineers and accountants, assembly line workers and welders, safety technicians and team leaders, managers, and techies, all to keep our six facilities running smoothly. Over 4 million vehicles have been produced in Newnan.
